M9V.error: frozen prefix shortened for goldsharp_m1.csv: expected 151494 rows, got 150000

root_cause.primary: The live M1 CSV is retained as a rolling file whose head can be removed. The monitors incorrectly require every initialization-time row to remain forever and therefore classify a harmless head truncation before all prospective starts as a frozen-prefix integrity failure.
root_cause.secondary: A short PermissionError/read-contention during CSV replacement is treated as a terminal forever-loop failure.

required_correction.M1_integrity: Replace full-file append-only prefix validation with rolling-window overlap validation. The exact prospective start and sufficient pre-start M1 lookback must remain present; subsequent cycles must verify an advancing overlap checkpoint hash.
required_correction.higher_timeframes: Keep strict frozen-prefix validation while their initialization prefixes remain physically present.
required_correction.transient_io: Retry PermissionError and unstable replacement reads without ending the forever loop; continue to fail closed on contract, runtime, start, timestamp-order, overlap-hash or genuine source-integrity violations.
required_correction.restart: After correction and one-time preserved-start migration audit, restart BAT03 only in dependency order. Never rerun BAT01.
